summary: iter202 — verified mixed-cart handling for POS checkout (sample + retail). Backend: SAMPLE_MIXED guard still active (POST /api/sales-orders order_type=regular + is_sample=true line -> 400 detail.code=SAMPLE_MIXED). order_type=sample forces every line to is_sample=true and number uses SOS- sequence. Pure regular cart submits normally. Frontend: added sample line of Batik Mega + sample line of Katun yarn (two sample lines) -> step-2 toggle-sample-<pid> converts first line to retail -> mixed-cart-notice appears ('Keranjang campur: 1 baris sampel + 1 baris ecer'), checkout-next disabled, pos-cart-kind-banner on SalesPortal reads 'Keranjang CAMPUR (sampel + ecer)'. mixed-cart-all-retail turns all lines into retail -> notice disappears, Next enables, step-3 checkout-submit label = 'Buat Sales Order' (regular SO flow). mixed-cart-keep-samples removes the retail line -> notice disappears, sample-billing-choice renders (Gratis/Berbayar chips); after picking Gratis step-3 submit label = 'Buat Pesanan Sampel (Gratis)'. No silent failure, no 500. (Note: when the kept sample line happened to be Benang Katun yarn, backend correctly rejected with a different guard — yarn-tahap not sellable to Sales — unrelated to SAMPLE_MIXED.)
critical_code_review_comments: Mixed-cart UX is well-handled on both ends: server rejects with structured code SAMPLE_MIXED and UI prevents submission with a clear bilingual notice + two single-click resolutions (all-retail / keep-samples). Both resolutions wire through state immutably (MixedCartNotice setCart(cur => ...)).

Minor polish: MixedCartNotice.jsx line 11 label counts work; however when samples==0 or retail==0 the component should never render (parent CheckoutDrawer already gates on `mixedCart = some sample && some retail`, so OK). No defensive guard needed.
SalesPortal pos-cart-kind-banner wording ('Keranjang CAMPUR (sampel + ecer) — pisahkan dulu di checkout sebelum membuat pesanan.') matches the task requirement.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 8 UI assertions pass across two scripts)
